$$
f(x,y)={\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}y, & (x,y)\in R\cap D \\ 0, & (x,y)\in R∖D\end{aligned}\,\text{and}\,{∬}_{D}{x}^{2}y\,\text{d}A={∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A,

which of the following could be the definition of the rectangular domain $R?$

- $R=[0,2]\times [-1,1]$
- $R=[-1,0]\times [0,1]$
- $R=[-1,2]\times [-2,2]$ Require the rectangle $R$ to contain all of $D$; choose rectangles for the zero-extension construction on a containing domain, rather than rectangles that happen to give the same integral by cancellation.
